location_model_design.selection_rationale: High runtime alignment with 60-cluster universe, seamless integration with candidate generator, robust Platt probability calibration, modular maintainability, and proven production compatibility without the latency overhead of pairwise LTR.

class_imbalance.positive_to_negative_ratio: 1 : 24 (4.0% positive rate when target is in candidate pool)
class_imbalance.strategy: Scale positive weight mildly (scale_pos_weight=1.0 to 2.5) or preserve native unweighted calibration to avoid probability sharpness distortion before Platt scaling.

calibration_design.test_contamination: ZERO — Held-out TEST split (2,250 cases) remains completely untouched until final locked evaluation.
calibration_design.probability_semantics: Calibrated relative posterior probability of cash-out occurrence across candidate locations within the prototype candidate-ranking framework.

time_model_design.uncertainty_strategy: Central point prediction with empirical error-band bounds derived on validation split. No unsubstantiated calibrated confidence interval claims.
